title: Decision Table: Vehicle Registration on File and Inspection Validity
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, the state of the vehicle registration on file when support records a passed vehicle inspection bears on the inspection validity days: the calendar days from the inspection date for which the inspection counts as the vehicle inspection on file.

## Rule

When the vehicle registration on file, the latest vehicle registration upload on the standing record, expired before the recording day, the inspection validity days change by -20 days; when it expires on the recording day or fewer than 30 days after it, they change by -10 days; when it expires later, they do not change.

The expiry date read is the one shown on the latest vehicle registration upload.

## Table

| Registration expiry date against the recording day | Change |
|---|---|
| before the recording day | -20 |
| on the recording day, or 1 to 29 days after | -10 |
| 30 days or more after | 0 |

## Edge rows (hypothetical, recording day 2026-03-10)

| Registration expiry date | Position | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-09 | expired the day before | -20 |
| 2026-03-10 | the recording day | -10 |
| 2026-04-08 | 29 days after | -10 |
| 2026-04-09 | 30 days after | 0 |
